messages:
samir: FYI running the FP8 AWQ bakeoff on L40s (cuda 12.3, triton 23.08) and hitting a small but consistent perplexity spike on long-context evals (~8k tokens). details below.
maria: can you paste the run command and container image?
samir: run: `docker run --gpus all ... redwood/awq-run:2026-03-18` and triton config below
samir: ```triton_config { backend: "tensorrt" allow_dynamic_batching: { max_queue_delay_microseconds: 1000 } }```
ben: what driver/kernel? cuda 12.3 / nvidia-driver 535?
samir: cuda 12.3, driver 535.86, tensorrt 8.8, trt-llm plugin 1.2. infra-bot shows recent node kernel update last week.
olivia: did you see any kernel fallback logs? triton sometimes silently chooses fp16 kernels when tensor cores mismatch.
samir: yes grep shows "WARN: kernel selected: fp16_fallback (tensorcore mismatch)" in runtime.log
samir: ```[2026-03-18T11:22:09Z] WARN kernel_select.cpp:78 kernel selected: fp16_fallback (requires fp8 quant)```
jules: curious — AWQ encoder expects packed fp8 format; fallback to fp16 will alter scaling/quant behavior => small but consistent accuracy delta.
maria: can you reproduce with vLLM path (no triton) for comparison?
samir: vllm path (cpu+cuda dispatch) reproduces baseline fp8 result (no spike) => suggests triton plugin path is the culprit
ben: hypothesis: libcudnn vs libcudart ABI mismatch causing kernel symbol selection. we upgraded libcudnn two weeks ago.
olivia: quick workaround: set TRITON_ENABLE_STRICT_KERNELOPT=1 or force kernel via env FORCE_FP8_KERNEL=1, can you try?
samir: tried FORCE_FP8_KERNEL=1 — perf dropped a bit but ppl matches fp16 baseline (i.e., no spike)
maria: good repro. can you gather a minimal repro script + tiny model and open a bug with nv/triton?
samir: will do, attaching repro commands and logs
samir: ```bash
# repro
docker run --gpus all -e FORCE_FP8_KERNEL=1 redwood/awq-run:2026-03-18 /bin/bash -c "python3 -m awq.eval --model tests/tiny_awq --context 8192 --batch 1"
```
deploy-bot: deployment redwood-triton/edge-42 upgraded -> kernel 5.15.21
ben: filing internal tracker RD-ml-2245, tagging infra + triton-ops + nv support @olivia
olivia: will loop in nv. also add test in our bakeoff harness: compare triton vs vllm for long-context with a smoke config and fail the run if ppl delta > 1.5
jules: also add an E2E alert that flips to cpu path if kernel fallback appears.
samir: thanks all :thumbsup:
